fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. Found that PR #164 already switched rhiza run abandon to git branch -d, and run-abandon-unmerged.txtar covers a never-pushed branch with no upstream. The model had no leaf for it, and nothing tested a branch with an upstream plus local commits never pushed to it. Linked the change set serves milestone-25 and relates-to the leafless draft 01M6B9FCNTTH65, then withdrew that draft. Raised the scope question; the arbiter ruled (Decision abandon-unpushed-branch-scope): one childless leaf under run-abandon, a test for the upstream case beside the no-upstream one, and a code change only if that test shows the branch deleted.
fields.title: Plan: abandon keeps an unpushed branch (autonomous)
